Remark
[weak harmonic norms and compactness]

Source: petersen:page-0454, petersen:page-0455 ↗ def:pet-ch11-harmonic-norm 1. ch11:11.6.15Define the weak (harmonic) norm $\| (M,g)\| ^{\mathrm{weak}}_{C^{m,\alpha },r}$ as in subsection 3.4, but require only that the charts $\varphi _s:B(0,r)\to U_s$ are immersions, so the inverse is only locally defined but still makes sense to be harmonic.

  1. Show that if $(M,g)$ has bounded sectional curvature, then for every $Q>0$ there is $r>0$ with $\| (M,g)\| ^{\mathrm{weak}}_{C^{m,\alpha },r}\le Q$; thus the weak norm is a generalized curvature quantity.

  2. Show the class of manifolds with bounded weak norm is precompact in the Gromov–Hausdorff topology.

  3. Show $(M,g)$ is flat iff the weak norm vanishes on all scales.
